messages:
alex: quick thought — should tenant-aware routing (model selection, cost tiering, region failover) live in the edge proxy or a delegate router service? concerned about latency and iteration speed.
riley: edge proxy wins on hop reduction and enforcing quotas early. also easier to short-circuit fallbacks. downside: edges get stateful and harder to change quickly.
sam: delegate router is attractive for policy centralization + canarying. single place to update complex decision logic. but adds an extra network hop which could sting at p95.
elaine: also consider transport: if edge speaks gRPC/proto to backend we get strong typing for routing metadata. but browser/3p clients still want JSON — that implies a transcoding layer.
michael: telemetry angle — console needs to show which policy chose a model, the score and the fallback reason. otherwise support will be chasing ghosts. we should emit a short decision trace per request.
alex: agreed. propose a minimal decision trace: tag = route:policy_name; reason = short_code; score=0.92. store sample traces with sampling and expose in Route Diagnostics in console.
devops-bot: deploy: router-v2-canary started in us-west-2 :rocket:
riley: thought: hybrid model? let edge handle fast deterministic rules (pin-to-model, tenant-override) and call delegate router for fuzzy/cost-based decisions. keeps edge lean for common paths.
sam: race condition on quotas if delegate enforces them — spikes could allow >limit before central state syncs. local token bucket cache with async reconciliation helps. TTLs matter.
elaine: small example of header-based decision payload we discussed:
```http
POST /v1/infer HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.dev
X-Tenant-ID: t-123
X-Route-Policy: cost_pref=low;latency=fast
Content-Type: application/proto+json
```
and config sketch for policy service: `policies/{tenant}/rules` with versioned proto message and rollout tags.
michael: streaming vs unary: streaming paths complicate retry/fallback semantics. fallbacking mid-stream is painful. if edge/proxy wants to swap to cheaper model on long-running stream, we need sticky routing or pre-allocated fallback plan.
alex: next steps — I'll run a perf microbenchmark with a delegate hop (us-west intra-zone) and estimate added p50/p95. also will mock the decision trace payload for the console. if numbers look OK, we can prototype hybrid.
riley: :thumbsup: keep the experiment small-landmark: 10% traffic, specific routes only.
sam: I'll work on local quota cache sim and a small correctness harness for races.
elaine: I'll draft the proto for policy rules and a minimal transcoding plan for gateway.
alex: cool. tagging folks for followups: @riley @sam @elaine @michael. thanks.
